characters.name: Duke Lorenzo De Valtieri
characters.flavorText: The calculating and pragmatic head of the family.

characters.name: Lady Celia De Valtieri
characters.flavorText: Lorenzo's younger sister, an enigmatic beauty rumored to dabble in alchemy.

characters.name: Giovanni Corsano
characters.flavorText: The patriarch known for consolidating power through daring ventures and black market operations.

characters.name: Marietta Corsano
characters.flavorText: Giovanni's fiercely independent daughter who oversees the family's espionage network.
